source.migration_note: The runes.js hash is historical: it pins the original SVG module as it existed at b8ea7233 (the original review's source commit); that file is no longer in the tree. glyph-catalog.mjs was the shared-source migration of that module with unchanged paths (sha256 60c2bb24…, committed in ae6cce9). This review describes the revised catalog pinned above, including refinements made to revised paths after the previous write of this file; entries were reconciled to those actual paths, which is a factual correction, not a new semantic approval. Clearance remarks use glyph-geometry.json: 32-unit canvas, stroke width 1.1, square caps, miter joins. Exactly 49 glyph paths differ from ae6cce9: the 43 entries previously marked revise plus six linked family members (State, Interface, ConstituentPower, OperativeKnowledge, WarrantedKnowledge, Attention). The other 66 paths are byte-identical; their entries were edited only to remove statements about counterparts' old paths and to record remaining concerns. Codepoints are unchanged. Ontology hashes are unchanged. Cross-catalog collision findings about historical Unicode candidates describe the pre-migration site. Risk wording records possible reader inferences, not entailments established by graphic composition.

method: Editorial review of each custom SVG glyph's actual drawn path in proposals/glyph-catalog.mjs (32-unit grid, rendered at stroke-width 1.1) against the full binding definition of its term. 'trial' means a defensible learned mnemonic to be shown with its label. 'revised' means the author redrew the glyph after the previous review (ae6cce9), either because it was marked revise or as a linked family member; it is a revised trial awaiting design and reader review, not approved and not semantically certified, and the entry records what the new motif addresses and what risk remains. 'revise' (currently assigned to no entry) means a glyph actively imports an entailment the definition denies, collides with an adjacent term, or relies on a cue too weak to distinguish it. Single-path meanings are mnemonics, not formal diagrams: stroke names in the catalog document design intent only, and junctions, enclosures and arrowheads do not assert Causal paths, proofs, entailments or exhaustive depictions. Judgments are not measured scores, reader studies, proofs of semantic equivalence, or claims that any reader innately decodes a glyph. Omitting part of a definition is not by itself grounds for revision. Stroke clearances are computed from path coordinates and the geometry specification, not from rendered or reader tests. This review update changed no glyph shape; it reconciles entry text to the pinned catalog paths.

relation_review.decision: Use two equal horizontal bars joined by a central vertical stroke extending four grid units beyond them. relation_review.scope: Only Relation's drawing changes; its font slot, definition and all other glyph paths are retained. Interface keeps the previous ordered-path motif. The new mark uses Identity's bar coordinates and the existing grid and stroke rules.
relation_review.open_gate: The double-dagger footnote reading and resemblance to Identity remain risks. Two bars do not limit Relation to two participants; graphic symmetry does not require a symmetric Relation, and the drawing does not specify ordered roles by itself. Retain labels; no reader study establishes recognition or small-size discrimination.

denotation_review.decision: Use a maps-to glyph: a vertical tail bar, horizontal stem and right-facing arrowhead. Daniel approved borrowing the expression-to-target roles of mathematical maps-to notation, without importing a function's uniqueness condition.
denotation_review.scope: Only Denotation's drawing changes. The existing font slot, all other glyph paths and all definitions are retained. The custom drawing follows the integer grid, uniform stroke and axial-angle guides; it does not depend on a system font's maps-to character.
denotation_review.open_gate: Within a function each input has one output, but Denotation only names an expression and its target; it does not require the same expression to denote the same target across uses. The arrow asserts neither causation, fidelity, Truth, Interpretation nor institutional status. Retain labels and test the tail at small sizes; no reader study establishes reliable interpretation.

Configuration remains the extensional Set construction in relational use, so the drawn edges do not prove a separate kind, participant closure, or mandatory Relation membership. Identifier consolidation remains open. Set may resemble the therefore sign; Configuration may resemble a triangular network or Change's triangle.

A missing outer edge is not negation, an open sector is not an omitted Relation, a stop is not Absence, and rightward or upward placement is not improvement. The flattened miniature, with its 1.8-unit arrowhead at full stroke width, is dense at text size. The converging pair shared with Attention and Care is gone, and Rule's glyph is now reused.

The Agent and the Order index are implicit, and the posts recall Standing without its exact geometry or role node. Very close to Authority's triangle between posts and Principal's posted fan; it may read as a molecule or network. Its hollow nodes differ from Configuration's solid dots.
entries.recommendation: Option B approved in permission_evidence_review. Retain with label; compare with Authority, Principal, Standing and Configuration.

entries.cue: Witness beyond control (IndependentFor B): an open-bottom Claim frame with a small hollow circle, a full-height separator and a compact eye beyond it: scoped independence of Witness, claimant, Claim, Observation and Order, both outside the claimant's Control and without relevant institutional Authority (D065).
entries.risk: Spatial separation is not independence: the separator is not a proven load-bearing Constraint, and absence of relevant Authority is not distinguished. The frame stands for the Claim, not the claimant, and the Order and Scope are not drawn. The eye imports visual seeing and may read as watching from behind a wall or surveillance. It recalls Claim, Witness and Action's barrier crossing.
entries.recommendation: Option B approved in permission_evidence_review. Retain with label; no mark certifies independence. Compare with Claim, Witness and Action.

entries.cue: Admitted Observation (Evidence B): a sheet holding a compact eye with a hollow pupil above Admission's V: an Observation produced by a Witness IndependentFor the claimant and Claim, admitted by the governing Order under an Admissibility Rule covering both (D066).
entries.risk: The V marks admission, not Truth: it does not license Evidence = Truth, and it may read as a check mark or download. The independent Witness, claimant, Claim and governing Admissibility Rule are not drawn. The sheet is Rule's and Capability's, not Observation's exact square, and the eye is compact with an r=1.5 pupil, so the Observation link is a near family resemblance. Shares the sheet and V with Admissibility Rule, differing by eye versus maps-to. The traced sheet and tiny square marker are gone. Evidential Bearing reuses this sheet and compact eye without the V (institution_person_review). Warranted Knowledge adds a smaller V to a factive record, without this sheet or eye (knowledge_status_sovereignty_review).
entries.recommendation: Option B approved in permission_evidence_review. Retain with label; compare with Observation, Admissibility Rule and Admission at text size.

entries.cue: Three-way evaluation (Evidential Bearing B): Evidence's sheet holding a raised compact eye with a hollow pupil, whose stem branches to three hollow endpoints: a Coordination Order-indexed evaluation of Evidence against a Claim under a Rule and Scope, recording one declared disposition, supporting, defeating or underdetermining (D104).
entries.risk: The three endpoints are the possible dispositions, not simultaneous results: each Evidential Bearing records one, unmarked here, and none means Truth. Their positions are unlabelled, so no endpoint is the supporting or defeating one by depiction, and the branch may read as a tree, menu, org chart or fork of choices. The Claim, evaluation Rule, Scope and recording Order are not drawn, and the eye imports visual seeing. It shares Evidence's sheet and compact eye but not the V, so it does not mean admission, and it differs from Evidence and Observation mainly by the branch. From path coordinates the endpoint rings sit one unit from the sheet's bottom edge, so their strokes touch it. The single support arrow is gone.
entries.recommendation: Option B approved in institution_person_review. Retain with label; state the recorded disposition in text. Compare with Evidence, Observation and Specification at text size.

entries.cue: Witnessed Claim (Attestation B): an open-bottom Claim frame holding a compact eye with a hollow pupil in place of Claim's token: a Claim made by a Witness about an Observation or Evidence under a Specification of the Witness's identity, Scope, Coordination Order and relevant independence (D067).
entries.risk: May read as a Claim about seeing, surveillance or a framed eye. The eye stands for the Witness's part, not vision, and certifies neither independence nor Truth; the required Specification and the attested Observation or Evidence are not drawn. There is no V: an Attestation is not thereby admitted or Evidence. The frame is wider than Claim's and the eye is compact, not Witness's eye on a baseline, so both links are near family resemblances. Close to Claim, Observation's eye in a sheet and Perception. The arbitrary cap and foot are gone.
entries.recommendation: Option B approved in institution_person_review. Retain with label; compare with Claim, Observation, Witness and Evidential Bearing.

entries.cue: Center between posts (Institution): Center's hub with four orthogonal hollow endpoints, reduced to 0.68, between two full-height domain posts: a Coordination Order that persists through Roles, Records, Interfaces and recurring Flows despite changes in its participating Agents (D068).

The posts are not Standing's exact geometry and do not draw Roles, Records, Interfaces, recurring Flows or persistence through changing Agents. Very close to Center itself and to the other figures between posts (Standing, Principal, Authority, Role, Permission Claim), and its r=1.36 rings are small at text size. Polity contains it at half scale and Constituent Power at quarter scale, where its rings close up (records_polity_review). It no longer shares rails with Coordination Order, Ledger no longer uses rails, and the stepped path's progress reading is gone.
entries.recommendation: Approved from the follow-up reroll in institution_person_review. Retain with label; compare with Center, Principal, Role and Authority at text size.

entries.risk: May read as a generic network hub, crosshair or plus sign. Constraints and their propagation are not explicitly drawn, so concentrating Flow is not distinguished from propagating Constraints; recurrence is implicit, and four routes do not fix four Flows. The hub is a drawing role, not an Agent, conscious planner or controller, and its fill is not Presence or Truth. Close to Entity's six-spoke fan, Principal and the Invariant and Persistence pivot fans. The old wheel and eight-spoke star are gone, so Symbol keeps the star alone.
entries.recommendation: Option C approved in institution_person_review. Retain with label stating a Center need not be an Agent; compare with Entity, Principal and Institution at text size.

The Institution is not drawn, and the reuse of Recognition's sheet and posts is a recognition mnemonic, not recorded Standing (D048). Dense at text size: the reduced mesh may read as a crossed-out box, an envelope or a form. Close to Recognition, Person, Map and Model. The tree and envelope-like square are gone.

entries.risk: Outside placement marks exclusion from the Canonical system only: it does not mean bad, false, secret, illegitimate or independent, and IndependentFor's separator is not reused. Persistence and being required for actual coordination are not drawn, and three nodes do not fix three members. The reduced Canonical system, its mesh at about 0.25, will close up at text size into a small boxed mark beside a bent path that may read as a chevron, export or link. The tree and open frame are gone, so it no longer reads as a scoped system.

entries.cue: Recorded Entity Standing (Person B): Principal's posts and Entity's six-spoke fan at radius 7 inside Recognition's record sheet: an Entity for which a Coordination Order records Standing to serve as a Principal or bear Consequences (D073).

The fan does not mean a conscious Agent, a human, Agency or moral personhood, and recording an Entity alone does not make a Person; the Coordination Order and Consequences are not drawn. Dense at text size: it differs from Principal only by the enclosing sheet and from Recognition by fan versus role, and its 2.8-unit edge trim differs slightly from Principal's 2.5. Person now rejoins the Entity, Principal and Recognition family; the ring and axis and their phi, power-symbol and U-like record readings are gone.
entries.recommendation: Option B approved in institution_person_review, repairing the Entity-family break. Retain with label; compare with Principal and Recognition and check all six hollow centers.

entries.cue: Action and context (Receipt C): a closed 26-unit square record sheet holding Action's hollow node and arrow, with Action's 3-unit node-to-arrow offset but without its barrier, above two context lines: a portable Record relating an Action to its Agent, Authority, Permission, Scope and observed Consequence (D074).
entries.risk: The arrow is a recorded Action, not an Action the Receipt performs or causes, and not a payment. The two lines are arbitrary text lines: they do not identify which of the Agent, Authority, Permission, Scope and observed Consequence are related, and portability is not drawn. A sheet holding an arrow and lines is close to Capability (condition line above an action arrow), Permission (arrow above a retention line), Record (hollow circle above a lower line) and Specification, and shares its 26-unit square sheet with Constituent Power and Consciousness Designation; it may read as a form, document or send icon. entries.cue: Typed record rows (Ledger B): a full-height sheet holding three ordered row lines, each led by a different marker (a hollow r=1.5 circle, a 3-unit square and a short diagonal): an ordered system of typed Records preserving their distinctions, producers and Standing (D075).
entries.risk: The three markers express typing without naming three particular Record types or limiting a Ledger to three; the circle, square and diagonal are not the Record, Representation or Difference glyphs. Producers and Standing are not drawn, and no row is marked true: a Ledger preserves history and standing but does not become Reality or Truth. May read as a list, checklist, menu or form, close to Specification's test sheet and Capability's sheet. The square, rails and bars are gone, so Identity's bars no longer appear in Ledger, it no longer shares rails with Coordination Order, and the squared-grid resemblance to the Unicode study's Model candidate is removed. Price, which D101 records in a Ledger, still does not reuse this form.
entries.recommendation: Option B approved in records_polity_review, retaining its slot. Retain with label; compare with Specification, Record and Capability at text size, and check the r=1.5 circle and 3-unit square marker.

entries.cue: Agents and Institution (Polity B): two Agent-like triangles of side 10 on axes, whose axes extend down and turn to the posts of the approved Institution drawing reduced by 0.5 below them: the plurality of Agents and Institutions whose recurring Actions enact and contest a political Coordination Order (D076).

The joined composition may still suggest unity or command; contestation, recurrence and the Coordination Order are not drawn. The triangles are Agent-like, not Agent's exact proportions. The reduced Institution is microscopic: at the 1.1 stroke its r=0.68 rings keep only about a 0.13-unit clear radius, so hollow endpoints and the solid hub close up, its square-capped 0.952-unit trims run into the rings, and its side endpoints sit about 0.3 unit from the posts. entries.risk: The Order is what the Agency transforms, not a frame it acts within: Constituent exercise is not a mere Action performed under a prior Permission or Authority of that Order, and the vertical stroke may instead read as governance, Control, command or attachment. The transformation itself is not drawn: the reduced Order is unchanged and Transformation's glyph is not reused. The eye imports vision, and the eye and arrow are Agency's cue at reduced size, not its exact geometry. The reduced Order is dense: its rails are 5 units apart and its cap's 0.5-unit overhang nearly merges with the rails at the 1.1 stroke; it may read as watching or ruling a ladder. The gate, arrow and legs are gone, removing the prior-Permission reading of Permission Exercise's former gate and the humanoid or crowd reading; Constituent Sovereignty has also left gate and legs and reuses neither this form nor Constituent Power (knowledge_status_sovereignty_review).
entries.recommendation: Option D approved in records_polity_review, retaining its slot. Retain with label; compare with Agency, Coordination Order, Control and Enforcement at text size.

entries.risk: Power is a Capability, not an occurrence: the arrow is an available route, not proof that a Constituent exercise occurred or that the Order was transformed, and the drawing does not reuse Constituent exercise's form. The sheet is Capability-like, not its exact sheet or condition line, and grants no Permission or Authority; persistence is not drawn. The nested Polity's Institution is at quarter scale: its r=0.34 rings have no clear center at the 1.1 stroke, so its hollow endpoints, solid hub, 0.476-unit trims and posts fuse into a small solid cross, with the side endpoints overlapping the posts by about 0.4 unit; the reduced Agents' side-5 triangles keep only about a 0.9-unit clear inradius and their axis tops touch the sheet's top edge. May read as a certificate or framed figures above a send arrow. The old staircase, its progress reading and the echo bars are gone.
